**Raffy A. Gonzalez** is a former Hot Wheels designer who interned at Mattel in 2003 and worked there from 2005 to 2007. Gonzalez interned at Mattel in 2003 and was noted as being one of the first interns to be "allowed" to design a car. After his internship, Gonzalez returned to Mattel in 2005 as a "freelance design vendor" and left in 2007; he then worked for Lance Powersports, a manufacturer of electric scooters. He is currently a design chief at Revision Design Studio.
